title_en: Psychology Made Simple (17/20): Day 21 of the Streak
note_en: 与其A，(不如/更重要的是)B weighs two options and rejects the first: 与其纠结具体是二十一天还是六十六天，更重要的是每天坚持重复 "rather than agonizing over whether it's 21 days or 66, what matters more is repeating it every day." 与其 always opens the first clause, like English "rather than," and the preferred option follows in the second clause, here introduced by 更重要的是.
